scripts.test: pnpm test:policy && pnpm test:root && pnpm -r test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm coverage:clean && pnpm coverage:root && pnpm -r test:coverage && pnpm coverage:mobile && pnpm coverage:offline-router && pnpm coverage:assert
scripts.coverage:root: c8 --all --check-coverage --lines 80 --functions 80 --branches 80 --reporter text --reporter lcov --reports-dir coverage/js/root --include 'tools/audit/*.mjs' --include 'tools/deploy/*-lib.mjs' --include 'tools/fixtures/*.mjs' --include 'tools/live/verify-api-lib.mjs' --exclude '**/*.test.mjs' node --test tools/audit/*.test.mjs tools/deploy/*.test.mjs tools/fixtures/*.test.mjs tools/live/*.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:mobile: c8 --check-coverage --lines 80 --functions 80 --branches 80 --reporter text --reporter lcov --reports-dir coverage/js/mobile --include apps/mobile/app.js --include 'apps/mobile/src/*.ts' node --import tsx --test apps/mobile/app.test.js apps/mobile/offline-contract.test.js apps/mobile/src/*.test.js
scripts.coverage:offline-router: c8 --check-coverage --lines 80 --functions 80 --branches 80 --reporter text --reporter lcov --reports-dir coverage/js/offline-router --include packages/offline-router/index.js node --test packages/offline-router/*.test.js
scripts.audit:public: pnpm audit:structure && pnpm audit:licenses && pnpm audit:denylist && pnpm audit:dependencies
